# Canary Secrets

A minimal, dedicated AS-MVP-001 (Epic K-007) fixture project. It exists
solely to exercise the certified `secrets.py` quarantine path end-to-end
through the AS-MVP-001 portfolio layer, per ADR-005's explicit design
("a fourth, minimal fixture project"). It is not one of the three
scored pilots (nebula, black-agency-os, dark-factory) and carries no
maturity/coverage expectations of its own.

This project's overview documentation is otherwise unremarkable.
